notes.title: Update for Caturday, September 12!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Fateful! We have a patch for you this fine Caturday to keep your tiles shaking and your temples totes grounded.

http://www.fatetectonics.com/external_assets/catlas.gif 


Version 1.8.4


	Tomes on tales. Add proper descriptions for final two Fates.
	Armageddon it. Fixed a series of issues related to meteor showers that can't finish because the world is destroyed too quickly.
	A+ for DJ. Fixed the Full House achievement.
	They’re already dead! Fixed several errors resulting from Fates trying to use disasters in places where tiles had fallen.
	Chaotic alignment. Small layout adjustment on the age summary screen.


Known Issues


	There’s an issues with Ragnorosa after “beating” the game that can cause the game to crash at the start of a new Age.
